description: Office of the Governor, Uva Province - Appointed Mr. K. B. Medawala as Chairman of the Uva Provincial Library Service Board, Appointed Mr. K. S. Lumara as member and Chairman of the Board of Directors of the Uva Provincial Road Passenger Transport Services Authority
categorisation: This gazette contains specific personnel appointments (Mr. K. B. Medawala and Mr. Kanagarathna Susil Kumara) to government boards/authorities with only their basic titles provided (Chairman of the Uva Provincial Library Service Board and Member and Chairman of the Board of Directors of the Uva Provincial Road Passenger Transport Services Authority). There are no detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas assigned to these individuals, making this a People Gazette (Type 2).
